statement: The simulator surface issues 18 requests, all same-origin: no font, no CDN, no analytics, no API.
reproduce: serve public/ and load /simulator/, counting network entries by origin
corrects: Superseded its own earlier figure of 14. Adopting the venue shell added /venue.css, /venue.js and /icons/favicon.svg to the page. The count moved; the claim that nothing leaves the origin did not, which is the part that was load-bearing.
